evidence: crates/susi-gawd-swarm/src/parallel_admission.rs (AdmissionLimits::measured derives capacity from the live host — available_parallelism, /proc/meminfo MemAvailable, and the accelerator probe — and persisted_default constructs the production AdmissionController with it; admit and probe both apply the AccelPool headroom rule before granting VRAM) and crates/susi-vendor-models/src/accel_reserve.rs (AccelPool headroom/admit/release, probe_vram_free_mb via nvidia-smi); pinned by crates/susi-gawd-swarm/src/tests/vc_201_043_mastery.rs (measured limits from host, operator override wins, unmeasured accelerator fails closed, concurrent reservations release and persist).
missing: VRAM probing covers NVIDIA via nvidia-smi only; non-NVIDIA accelerators report unmeasured and fail closed unless the operator sets SUSI_ADMIT_VRAM_MB. Reservations are controller bookkeeping — they gate susi-admitted work but do not stop an external process from consuming VRAM after admission. The safety headroom is a fixed 5% of measured capacity, not adaptive to device count or load.
